before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the first visit)
which visit: the business's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
how you'll pay: yourself, or a plan by name only (a health plan, the VA, a work-injury or car-accident claim)
days and times that suit you
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like a wheelchair or an interpreter
for a home visit: who meets the acupuncturist at the door, and a quiet room with space for the table
secure_page_only: the plan's member ID and a photo of the card, or the claim number
the health flags the acupuncturist reads before the visit: pregnant or could be, blood thinners or a bleeding problem, a pacemaker or other implant, fainting with needles
consent to treatment and the privacy notice; the health answers get their own yes
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18
intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, reasons or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat; only a visit type from the list and the time pass through the AI
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (the child's visit, with no needles); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent (a switch)

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden weakness or numbness, a drooping face, or a sudden very bad headache
stop.say: This sounds like an emergency. Call 911 now. Don't wait for an acupuncture visit.

stop.words: a fall with a head injury, or someone who can't get up
stop.booking: no booking until they're safe; otherwise the safety steps come first, then the booking goes on

go_on.words: pain, stress or poor sleep with nothing else
go_on.what: matched to the business's own visit types; Rosie never judges how urgent it is, and gives no health advice
the safety step 'rest at home: the visit can move with no fee', then the booking goes on

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, the health flags and the consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before a first visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder
steps.who: every new patient; a returning patient's history stays on file a year, with a short health update before each visit
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (filled in on the secure page at the desk or the door, before any needles), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The acupuncturist reads the health answers
steps.when: after booking, before the visit (A7-x01, B7-x01)
steps.result: nothing stands out: the visit stays; a flag to talk over: the acupuncturist calls first and may change the treatment (no electro-acupuncture with a pacemaker; other points in pregnancy; acupressure with no needles at its own price); not right for acupuncture now: the acupuncturist calls and says who to see, then the visit is cancelled with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk or Sam, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan or a claim
steps.result: covered, part covered, not covered (self-pay with the estimate notice), or can't check now (checked later; the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example clinic's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk with its due date; one estimate can cover a series of follow-ups

steps.name: A doctor's referral or OK
steps.when: before the visit, where a plan or the state's rules ask for one (a switch)
steps.who: the business gets it, office to office
steps.result: not in by the due time: Sam calls; the visit moves with no fee, or goes ahead at the self-pay price with the patient's yes

steps.name: A reaction last time
steps.who: a patient who felt faint at an earlier visit
steps.result: the booking waits for the owner's OK; the reason stays in the record, never in a text

first_steps_and_forms.prep: wear loose clothes; eat a light meal first; finish the health update; at home: a quiet room with space for the table

staff.skills: every acupuncturist: first visits, follow-ups, cupping and acupressure; child's visits only for those trained in them (the example: Iris); herbal consults only with the herbal certificate where the state's form asks (the example: Noah); home visits only for those Sam clears
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each acupuncturist's own license, per state, for the place where the patient is seen
staff.supervision: none for a licensed acupuncturist; a student works only under supervision, where the state's rules allow it at all (a switch); none at the example businesses
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day visits, a booking after a reaction last time, and anything the acupuncturist flags
staff.stand_in: another licensed acupuncturist may stand in, on a time the patient picks or OKs; the notes go with the booking on the secure side; only the acupuncturist decides what's safe

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child (the child's visit, with no needles); a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent (a switch)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk (where Sam sets a time with nobody at the desk, like Iris's Saturday mornings alone, the acupuncturist enters it); at home: the code at the door, from the patient or whoever lets the acupuncturist in
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the treatment notes (points used, needle count, any reaction) stay in the business's own chart and on the secure page, never in a text
visit.changes_at_visit: feels faint: the needles come out, the patient lies flat with water, gentle hands-on work instead, noted for next time; no needles wanted: cupping or acupressure at the agreed price; a fever or another sign the plug-in names: no needles that day; electro-acupuncture only when the acupuncturist decides, never with a pacemaker or other implant
visit.before_work: the acupuncturist goes over the health answers and how the patient feels today before any needles (a tongue and pulse check is a usual part), in the business's own chart

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always where the state licenses acupuncture: each acupuncturist holds their own active license from the state's board, under the title that state uses; a few states issue none (a switch from the state form)
license.who: each person; the business too where the state's form registers acupuncture clinics or their owners
license.ask: each acupuncturist's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the business's registration number from the owner, where the state asks
license.insurance: malpractice insurance on file where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts to a patient carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the place, money lines and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the health answers or any result; a clinic text names no acupuncturist; a home visit keeps the acupuncturist's name for the door check
